reason: It's one apartment next to my house; Booking and Airbnb already send my scheduled messages and the rules sheet is on the table, and if a guest is stuck they knock on my door. On what I earn, €120 for something I already have covered is not happening.
objection: I don't see what it does that my scheduled messages and the printed sheet don't, and I'm still not sure I'm allowed to put guests' questions through some AI, even with a signed paper.
would_change_my_mind: A neighbour with one unit like mine showing me it really stopped the late-night calls, at a price closer to €5 a month.
